title: Films Drenched in Drama
intro: These are films that grip your chest and refuse to let go. Pour something strong and surrender to the drama.

films.title: Incendies
films.line: A mother's silence unravels into a truth so devastating it rewrites everything.

films.title: Prisoners
films.line: Desperation and moral collapse collide in the longest, darkest night imaginable.

films.title: Oldboy
films.line: Revenge burns so bright here it scorches the hand holding the match.

films.title: Requiem for a Dream
films.line: Four people chase the warmth of a dream until the wanting consumes them whole.

films.title: Gone Girl
films.blurb: On their fifth anniversary Nick comes home and Amy is gone. Gillian Flynn adapted her own novel, and Fincher kept her on for the whole project instead of swapping in a screenwriter after the first draft, which almost never happens. Rosamund Pike's Amy earned an Oscar nomination, the film took $370 million, and the cool girl monologue is still quoted. A thriller on the surface and a marriage underneath, which is the scarier film.

films.title: A Separation
films.line: Two people pulling apart slowly drag everyone they love into the wreckage with them.

films.title: Burning
films.line: A slow obsession ignites into something you can never quite explain.

films.title: Parasite
films.line: Class, desire, and a single lie spiral into beautiful irreversible chaos.

films.title: Blue Ruin
films.line: Revenge looked so simple until every step made everything so much worse.

films.title: Hereditary
films.line: Grief tears a family open and something far darker crawls inside.
